name: mods
description: The switchboard for your mods. /mods opens a pane that finds every mod on this Mac (your folders, marketplaces, this chat's own), turns each one on or off in every chat, hides or shows it, and opens the side-pane ones.

mod_folders.title: Folders that hold your mods
mod_folders.description: Folders to look in for mods, one folder per mod inside each. Separate several with a colon. ~ means your home folder.
